## Forms · List Workflows → `n8n_listWorkflows(actor, {type, status, step, since, employeeName, limit, offset})`
Reads *Dashboard_View*. Filters (all optional, AND-ed): `type` = `Onboarding | End of Employment | Status Change | Equipment` **or** an id prefix (`NEW_EMP_`, `TERM_`, `CHANGE_`, `EQUIP_REQ_`); `status` = exact Global Status; `step` = substring of Granular Step (case-insensitive); `since` = ISO date, Last Updated ≥ since; `employeeName` substring; `limit` (default 100, max 500); `offset`.
Returns `{ workflows:[{ workflowId, type, <every Dashboard_View header>… }], count, total, offset, limit, source }`. Add a *Split Out* on `workflows` for one item per workflow.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
